title_en: Malaysia Airlines Orders Up To 16 Boeing 787-10s, Deliveries Start 2032
title_zh: 马来西亚航空订购多达 16 架波音 787-10，将于 2032 年开始交付
summary: Malaysia Airlines has placed its first-ever Dreamliner order: 10 firm Boeing 787-10s plus six options, with deliveries from 2032 to 2035. Here's how it fits the fleet.
summary_zh: 马来西亚航空 (Malaysia Airlines) 已下达首个梦想客机订单：10 架波音 787-10 飞机以及 6 架选装飞机，交付时间为 2032 年至 2035 年。
body_en: Malaysia Airlines has just placed a new aircraft order , as the airline will be adding a new wide body aircraft type to its fleet. This seems logical enough, even if the carrier’s long haul fleet seems rather diversified at this point.
Malaysia Airlines will add largest Dreamliner to fleet

Malaysia Airlines has placed its first-ever Dreamliner order, as the airline will be taking delivery of up to 16 Boeing 787-10s. This includes a firm order for 10 jets, plus options for six more, with deliveries expected between 2032 and 2035.

For context, the 787-10 is the largest variant of the Dreamliner. While it has the least range of any 787 variant, the per-seat economics are great, given how it’s “stretched.” While some airlines have started to use the 787-10 for high capacity regional routes, Malaysia Airlines is taking a different approach.

The oneworld carrier intends to use these planes to support its long haul fleet modernization and international expansion, including routes to Europe, along with destinations throughout Asia-Pacific. The airline points out how long haul demand to and from Southeast Asia has increased by more than 50% over the past decade.
Here’s how Malaysia Airlines Group CEO Nasaruddin Bakar describes this

“The acquisition of the 787 Dreamliner represents a strategic investment in the future of Malaysia Aviation Group. As we look ahead to the next phase of growth, these aircraft will strengthen our ability to serve key international markets with greater capacity, efficiency and flexibility, while delivering the elevated travel experience our customers expect. Beyond fleet renewal, this investment reinforces our commitment to maintaining a modern, competitive airline that supports Malaysia’s connectivity and global aspirations.”
How the Dreamliner fits into Malaysia Airlines’ fleet
For context, Malaysia Airlines currently has a fleet of just over 90 aircraft, with another 75 aircraft on firm order. As it stands, Malaysia Airlines has
27 Airbus A330s, including three A330-200s, 13 A330-300s, and 11 A330-900neos
57 Boeing 737s, including 38 737-800s and 19 737 MAX 8s
Now the airline has the following planes on firm order
36 Boeing 737 MAXs, including 24 737 MAX 8s and 12 737 MAX 10s

A few things stand out here. First of all, it’s cool to see Malaysia Airlines growing again, after a rather rough… what, nearly 15 years? At this point the airline has enough planes on order to both replace its previous generation fleet, and expand. I’d expect the 16 A330ceos will be retired at some point in the coming years, and more than replaced by the A330neos that remain on order. Furthermore, the 737-800s will all be replaced by the 737 MAXs.
The 787-10 is an incredible plane in terms of economics, especially as Boeing has been able to make incremental range improvements, turning it into a true long haul aircraft.

At the same time, I can’t help but feel like it’s unusual how the airline has just seven A350s, with no more on order, and is now switching to the 787 for fleet renewal. Admittedly the A350 was ordered back in the day under a completely different management team, which also at one point thought the A380 was a good fit for the airline.

So I am curious how the carrier’s fleet evolves. Will the seven A350s stick around, or will they eventually just be replaced by 787-10s? Even with airspace restrictions and headwinds, it seems like all of Malaysia Airlines’ routes should be within range for the 787-10, though admittedly London (LHR) might be on the cusp, depending on how airspace closures evolve, how dense of a configuration the airline selects, etc.

The big challenge with the airline industry is that it’s never static, and decisions aren’t made in a vacuum. One management team makes one decision, and then a management team later on can’t just undo what the other management team did, without it being costly. So I get that they’re doing what they can…

Malaysia Airlines is the newest customer for the Boeing 787, as the airline has ordered up to 16 787-10s, including 10 firm orders and six options. The airline plans to use this for a long haul expansion to Europe, as well as for flights in Asia-Pacific.

It’s cool to see Malaysia Airlines continuing to grow, as the carrier has quite the order book at this point. I am curious if the airline keeps around the seven A350s in the long run, or how the airline manages its three wide body aircraft types.
body_zh: 马来西亚航空公司刚刚下了一份新飞机订单，该航空公司将为其机队添加一种新的宽体飞机类型。这似乎很合乎逻辑，即使该航空公司的长途机队目前看起来相当多元化。
马来西亚航空将在机队中增加最大的梦想客机
马来西亚航空 (Malaysia Airlines) 已发出其首个梦想客机订单，该航空公司将接收多达 16 架波音 787-10 飞机。其中包括 10 架喷气式飞机的确定订单，以及另外六架喷气式飞机的选项，预计将于 2032 年至 2035 年期间交付。
就上下文而言，787-10 是梦想飞机的最大型号。虽然它的航程是所有 787 机型中最短的，但考虑到它的“延伸性”，每座的经济性非常好。虽然一些航空公司已开始使用 787-10 执飞高容量支线航线，但马来西亚航空公司却采取了不同的做法。
这家寰宇一家航空公司打算利用这些飞机支持其长途机队现代化和国际扩张，包括飞往欧洲以及整个亚太地区的航线。该航空公司指出，在过去十年中，往返东南亚的长途航线需求增长了 50% 以上。
马来西亚航空集团首席执行官 Nasaruddin Bakar 是这样描述的
MAG 总裁兼集团首席执行官 Nasaruddin A. Bakar 机长表示：“收购 787 梦想飞机代表着对马来西亚航空集团未来的战略投资。”他表示，这架飞机将增强该集团“以更大的容量、效率和灵活性”服务主要国际市场的能力。
梦想飞机如何融入马来西亚航空机队
就背景而言，马来西亚航空公司目前拥有超过 90 架飞机的机队，另有 75 架飞机已确认订购。目前，马来西亚航空已
现在该航空公司已确认订购以下飞机
36 架波音 737 MAX，包括 24 737 MAX 8 和 12 737 MAX 10
这里有一些事情很突出。首先，很高兴看到马来西亚航空在经历了相当艰难的……什么，近 15 年之后再次增长？目前，该航空公司已订购足够的飞机来替换其上一代机队并扩大规模。我预计 16 架 A330ceo 将在未来几年的某个时候退役，并被仍在订购的 A330neo 所取代。此外，737-800s将全部被737 MAXs取代。
就经济性而言，787-10 是一架令人难以置信的飞机，特别是波音公司能够逐步改进航程，将其变成真正的长途飞机。
与此同时，我不禁觉得这家航空公司只有 7 架 A350，而且没有更多订单，现在又改用 787 进行机队更新，这很不寻常。诚然，A350 是在当天由完全不同的管理团队订购的，该团队也一度认为 A380 非常适合该航空公司。
所以我很好奇航母的机队是如何演变的。七架 A350 会继续存在，还是最终会被 787-10 取代？即使存在空域限制和逆风，马来西亚航空的所有航线似乎都应该在 787-10 的范围内，不过不可否认，伦敦 (LHR) 可能处于风口浪尖，具体取决于空域关闭的演变情况、航空公司选择的配置密度等。
航空业面临的巨大挑战是它永远不是静态的，决策也不是在真空中做出的。一个管理团队做出一个决定，然后一个管理团队就不能简单地撤销另一个管理团队所做的事情，否则会付出高昂的代价。所以我知道他们正在尽其所能......
马来西亚航空是波音 787 的最新客户，该航空公司已订购了多达 16 架 787-10，其中包括 10 架确认订单和 6 架选择订单。该航空公司计划利用这一点来拓展飞往欧洲的长途航线以及亚太地区的航班。
看到马来西亚航空继续增长真是太棒了，因为该航空公司目前拥有相当多的订单。我很好奇该航空公司从长远来看是否会保留七架 A350，或者该航空公司如何管理其三种宽体飞机。

body_en: Norse Atlantic Airways warns of critical financial situation, seeks emergency funding - Aviation24.be

Norse Atlantic Airways has warned that its financial situation is critical and that it needs additional financing to continue operations. The Norwegian long-haul low-cost carrier made the announcement on 25 November, saying it is dependent on securing funding to meet its short-term liquidity requirements.

The airline, supported by financial advisors, has explored several strategic alternatives, including a potential takeover. Norse is also holding discussions with selected parties about short-term financing and continues to consider additional aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance (ACMI) agreements. However, the company warned that there can be no assurance that the financing discussions will result in a viable solution.

The financial difficulties follow a challenging year for the airline. Norse recently lost its agreement with Indian carrier IndiGo, which had involved six Boeing 787-9 aircraft, representing half of its 12-aircraft fleet. The airline subsequently signed an ACMI agreement with Pakistan International Airlines for two Boeing 787-9s, while significantly reducing its own scheduled network.

Despite reporting a 94.9% load factor in October and a 19% year-on-year increase in unit revenue, Norse has struggled with rising fuel costs and the loss of important aircraft leasing revenue. Its shares plunged following Wednesday’s announcement, reflecting growing concerns about the airline’s future.
Norse Atlantic Airways said it would provide further information when appropriate. Its immediate future now depends on securing additional funding or finding a strategic investor or takeover partner.

挪威大西洋航空公司警告称，其财务状况严峻，需要额外融资才能继续运营。这家挪威长途低成本航空公司于 11 月 25 日宣布这一消息，称其依赖融资来满足短期流动性需求。
该航空公司在财务顾问的支持下，探索了多种战略选择，包括潜在的收购。 Norse 还与选定的各方就短期融资进行讨论，并继续考虑额外的飞机、机组人员、维护和保险 (ACMI) 协议。然而，该公司警告称，不能保证融资讨论将产生可行的解决方案。
该航空公司经历了充满挑战的一年，随后出现了财务困难。 Norse 最近失去了与印度航空公司 IndiGo 的协议，该协议涉及 6 架波音 787-9 飞机，占其 12 架飞机机队的一半。该航空公司随后与巴基斯坦国际航空公司签署了 ACMI 协议，购买两架波音 787-9，同时大幅缩减其自身的定期航线网络。
尽管 10 月份的载客率达到 94.9%，单位收入同比增长 19%，但 Norse 仍面临燃油成本上涨和重要飞机租赁收入损失的困境。周三宣布这一消息后，该公司股价暴跌，反映出人们对该航空公司的未来日益担忧。
挪威大西洋航空公司表示将在适当的时候提供进一步的信息。它的近期未来现在取决于获得额外资金或寻找战略投资者或收购伙伴。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

As the northern aviation winter season is here, airlines are increasingly finalizing their plans for next summer. Initial information for Q3 2027 (July-September) shows that Delta Air Lines is planning 258 daily international departures in the all-important period (double for total movements).

The SkyTeam member's offering is currently expected to be 6% higher than for Q3 2026, with 14 daily departures added. It will be the seventh-highest volume on record for that quarter. However, it is subject to change, as Delta firms up its plan. Still, 15 new and returning routes will help , some of which will be operating in the third quarter of 2027, having not done so in 2026.
Delta Is Launching These Eight Medium & Long-Haul Routes

For this article, Delta's international network in Q3 2026 was compared to what is planned for Q3 2027 using Cirium Diio data. 15 international routes were identified, eight of which are long-haul. As all markets have already been officially announced, this article simply summarizes what is happening and provides some additional context.

Only routes that have already been disclosed and are scheduled are included. As such, any upcoming new link from Seattle, expected to be revealed on December 2 , is excluded. While flights to Singapore have been increasingly speculated, this is not entirely certain. Even so, it is unclear when, precisely, they'd begin.
Medium & Long-Haul Routes: Didn't Operate In Q3 2026 But Will In Q3 2027
A brand-new market. The launch was postponed for half a year. Suggestions that this will be delayed to the second half of 2027

A brand-new market. It'll connect the Texas capital with the hugely important European SkyTeam hub. It'll be Delta's only long-haul route from Austin. Interestingly, flights will arrive in Texas at 4:52 PM and leave at 3:15 PM. Is another route coming?!

Previously served in 2021. Replaces Detroit-Reykjavík Keflavík, which Delta last served in 2026. Delta ended that route shortly after Icelandair did. Boston-Reykjavík Keflavík will be the airline's new shortest route to Europe
A brand-new market . Venice is the largest unserved European city from Boston
A brand-new market. The capital of Greece is the #1 unserved European market from Detroit
New for Delta, but Northwest flew via Tokyo Narita until 2009 using the 747-400. Delta flew to the Philippines via Narita until 2020, just not beginning/ending in Los Angeles
Inherited from Northwest. Delta previously operated until 2020

None of the following links are brand-new, which is perhaps not surprising. None of them are new to Delta's map in 2026, although two links were inaugurated in December 2025. They include Austin to Los Cabos, with Delta joining American (albeit only January, March, and April 2027) and Southwest. In Q3 2027, Delta's offering contributes to that market having a record number of flights.

Many of the entries are markets that Delta already serves. They are simply included because flights did not operate in Q3 2026 but are scheduled to do so in the same quarter next year . In many ways, this is a vote of confidence for a route. Obviously, the reverse (a shorter operating period with fewer flights and less capacity) may indicate problems. Just ask Southwest about one of its links to Alaska .

随着北方航空冬季季节的到来，航空公司越来越多地敲定明年夏季的计划。 2027 年第三季度（7 月至 9 月）的初步信息显示，达美航空计划在这一重要时期每天运营 258 趟国际航班（总起降量翻倍）。
目前，天合联盟成员的航班数量预计将比 2026 年第三季度增加 6%，每天增加 14 班航班。这将是该季度有记录以来第七高的销量。然而，随着达美航空坚定其计划，它可能会发生变化。尽管如此，15 条新航线和返程航线仍将有所帮助，其中一些航线将在 2027 年第三季度运营，而 2026 年尚未运营。
达美航空将开通这八条中长途航线

仅包括已公开和已安排的路线。因此，预计将于 12 月 2 日公布的任何来自西雅图的新链接均被排除在外。尽管人们越来越多地猜测飞往新加坡的航班，但这并不完全确定。即便如此，目前还不清楚他们具体什么时候开始。

许多条目都是达美航空已经服务的市场。之所以将其包含在内，是因为航班在 2026 年第三季度没有运营，但计划在明年同一季度运营。从很多方面来说，这是对一条路线的信任投票。显然，反之（较短的运营期、较少的航班和较少的运力）可能表明存在问题。只要询问西南航空关于其与阿拉斯加的联系之一即可。

title_en: The Forgotten Pacific Airfield Where WWII Fighter Jets Are Being Reclaimed By The Jungle
title_zh: 被遗忘的太平洋机场，二战战斗机正在被丛林收复
summary: The island of Yap is full of lost Japanese WWII aircraft wrecks, with some US aircraft like Corsairs also to be found.
summary_zh: 雅浦岛到处都是二战时期日本失落的飞机残骸，还发现了一些美国飞机，如海盗船。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

It is well known that many World War II fighter wrecks lie across the islands of the Pacific. Many of these are lost, forgotten, or abandoned, left to rot in jungles. Others lie in shallow waters, becoming refuges for marine life and attractions for today's divers. In October and November, I visited the island nations of Palau and the Federated States of Micronesia FSM (Yap Island), where the remains of WWII are everywhere. Only a very limited number of rather niche divers seem to be the only true tourists Yap attracts today.

While various Japanese bunkers, radio buildings, light-rail trains, and guns are found across Palau, most of the fighting is on the smaller island of Peleliu. Unfortunately, I didn't visit Peleliu, although I did visit Yap. Peleliu was the site of one of the deadliest Marine operations. Conversely, invasion plans for Yap were scrapped, and the island was bombarded and bypassed. Today, visitors can see Japanese WWII aircraft lying, reclaimed by the jungle where they were destroyed .

The island of Yap was controlled by Spain until the Spanish-American War of 1898, when it lost Cuba, Puerto Rico, the Philippines, and Guam to the United States. Spain was left with a large expanse of small Micronesian islands that the United States did not take over but could not defend. It promptly sold the islands to the emerging German Empire.

As World War I broke out, Japan quickly seized most of the German Pacific islands, although Australia took Nauru and New Guinea and New Zealand took German Samoa. The former German islands were then run by Japan under the League of Nations South Seas Mandate. It appears from Japanese colonization of the islands that Japan planned to integrate these islands, including Yap, into Japan proper, although this never happened.

When the Pacific War broke out, Japan had managed Yap for around 35 years and was busy populating the island. During the war, it fortified the islands to create a defensive ring to defend the Japanese home islands. The US Navy launched its famous island-hopping campaign to bring its bombers within range of the home islands. For a brief period of time in 1944, Yap found itself at the center of the Pacific War.

The Japanese military buildup on Yap began relatively late, and it was not heavily fortified before the Pacific War. The island lacked a good natural harbor and had few natural defensive strong points. The most significant Japanese installation was the airfield at Lamer, located adjacent to the modern Yap International Airport.

The runway was built using reef material, although locals told me that the Japanese also used thousands of their famous money stones (Rai). By April 1944, the main strip was completed while some of the supporting infrastructure was unfinished. The site's main purpose was to establish an air transit and staging point for Japanese aircraft moving across the region. The combined Japanese Army and Navy garrison on the island totaled around 4,000 to 5,000 men.

The US had intended to invade the island, but instead opted for bombing, neutralizing, and bypassing it. By May and June, Japan was deploying aircraft to the island. American reconnaissance reported 24 Japanese fighters, six dive bombers, two medium bombers, and six night fighters. The aircraft soon became a target for American long-range B-24 bombers . By September, Americans were encountering little or no aerial resistance from the island.

After the war, the bombed-out Japanese airfield appears to have been abandoned. The forests regrew and reclaimed the airfield, while locals treated the runway as a roadway and built their homes along it. Today, some Japanese wrecks are located next to homes. Visitors can go and explore the old airbase and find the wrecks, as I did. There are World War II marker signs at most of the notable wrecks, but some are not marked. The signs are often not maintained and can be lost over time.

Almost all the land on Yap is privately owned, and visitors are expected to ask landowners for permission before seeing the wrecks, even if they are marked and signed. In all, I found the wrecks of around eight Japanese aircraft, including a Mitsubishi G4M 'Betty' bomber. Bizarrely, the Betty bomber now lies next to a Boeing 727 that crashed next to it decades later.

The runway is in poor shape, and it is extensively potholed and overgrown. It is lined with abandoned cars rotting in the jungle. Yap may be famous for its stone money, but having explored the island, it is hard not to also associate it with endless abandoned, decaying cars. Aircraft wrecks can generally be found between 150 and 300 feet (45 to 91 meters) from the runway.

The Mitsubishi G4M bomber is one of the most notable wrecks . It was a medium bomber/torpedo bomber, with Japan building 2,435 examples of the type. It had a crew of seven. Another notable wreck is a Japanese Nakajima B5N Torpedo Bomber. These were three-man carrier-based torpedo bombers, of which Japan built 1,149 units. A number of Mitsubishi A6M Zero fighters can also be found.

I found two small tails of wrecked aircraft that I assumed were Zeros, but they were unmarked, and I couldn't tell for sure. The Google Maps screenshot above marks the locations on the old airfield where I found Japanese wrecks. There are likely many more to be found, but this is private land, and the jungle is extremely thick, making movement and visibility very difficult.
Japanese aircraft on Yap (per 1944 US reconnaissance )

All around the airfield, large bomb craters from US bomb strikes are visible. I am used to finding these bomb craters in Vietnam. Many are visible at Vietnam's historic site of My Son, but they always seem to be difficult to make out in photos, especially when they are surrounded by thick jungles. One of the aircraft wrecks I found was next to a bomb crater, and I had to climb in and out of the crater to get around what was left of the aircraft.

Across the island, I saw many other remains of WWII. These include a well-marked Japanese Type 88 75mm anti-air gun preserved next to some Zero fighters . On the main hill overlooking the main settlement of Colonia, I found four more Japanese guns with the barrels destroyed. These were marked, but they are overgrown, and the signs have largely disappeared.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
众所周知，太平洋岛屿上散布着许多二战战斗机残骸。其中许多都丢失、被遗忘或被遗弃，在丛林中腐烂。其他的则位于浅水中，成为海洋生物的避难所和当今潜水员的景点。 10月和11月，我访问了帕劳岛国和密克罗尼西亚联邦（雅浦岛），那里到处都是二战遗迹。如今，雅浦岛吸引的唯一真正的游客似乎只有数量非常有限的小众潜水员。
虽然帕劳各地都有各种日本掩体、无线电大楼、轻轨列车和枪支，但大部分战斗发生在较小的贝里琉岛。不幸的是，虽然我访问了雅浦岛，但我没有访问贝里琉岛。贝里琉岛是海军陆战队伤亡最惨重的行动之一。相反，雅浦岛的入侵计划被取消，该岛遭到轰炸并被绕过。今天，游客可以看到日本二战飞机躺在被摧毁的丛林中。
雅浦岛一直由西班牙控制，直到 1898 年美西战争，当时雅浦岛将古巴、波多黎各、菲律宾和关岛拱手让给了美国。西班牙留下了大片密克罗尼西亚小岛，美国没有接管但也无法保卫这些岛屿。它立即将这些岛屿卖给了新兴的德意志帝国。
第一次世界大战爆发后，日本迅速占领了大部分德属太平洋岛屿，澳大利亚占领了瑙鲁和新几内亚，新西兰占领了德属萨摩亚。这些前德国岛屿随后由日本根据国际联盟南海托管管辖权管理。从日本对这些岛屿的殖民统治来看，日本计划将包括雅浦岛在内的这些岛屿纳入日本本土，尽管这从未发生过。
太平洋战争爆发时，日本管理雅浦岛约 35 年，并忙于在岛上繁衍人口。战争期间，它在岛屿上筑垒，形成防御圈，保卫日本本土。美国海军发起了著名的跳岛行动，将轰炸机带到本岛的射程内。 1944 年的一段短暂时间内，雅浦发现自己处于太平洋战争的中心。
日本在雅浦岛的军事集结起步较晚，在太平洋战争之前也没有重兵防守。该岛缺乏良好的天然良港，自然防御据点也很少。日本最重要的设施是位于现代雅浦国际机场附近的拉默机场。
跑道是用珊瑚礁材料建造的，尽管当地人告诉我，日本人也使用了数千颗他们著名的金钱石（Rai）。到 1944 年 4 月，主要地带已竣工，但一些配套基础设施尚未完工。该站点的主要目的是为穿越该地区的日本飞机建立一个空中过境和中转站。日本陆军和海军在岛上的驻军总数约为 4,000 至 5,000 人。
美国原本打算入侵该岛，但最终选择了轰炸、压制和绕行。到五月和六月，日本已向该岛部署飞机。美国侦察报告称，有 24 架日本战斗机、六架俯冲轰炸机、两架中型轰炸机和六架夜间战斗机。该机很快成为美国远程 B-24 轰炸机的目标。到九月，美国人几乎没有遇到来自该岛的空中抵抗。
战后，被炸毁的日本机场似乎已被废弃。森林重新生长并开垦了机场，而当地人则将跑道视为道路并沿其建造了房屋。如今，一些日本沉船残骸位于房屋旁边。游客可以像我一样去探索旧空军基地并寻找残骸。大多数著名沉船残骸上都有二战标记，但也有一些没有标记。这些标志通常得不到维护，并且随着时间的推移可能会丢失。
雅浦岛几乎所有土地都是私人拥有的，游客在观看沉船之前应该征求土地所有者的许可，即使它们有标记和签名。我总共发现了大约八架日本飞机的残骸，其中包括一架三菱 G4M“贝蒂”轰炸机。奇怪的是，贝蒂轰炸机现在躺在一架几十年后坠毁的波音 727 飞机旁边。
跑道状况不佳，坑坑洼洼，杂草丛生。它两旁都是在丛林中腐烂的废弃汽车。雅浦岛可能因其石钱而闻名，但探索过这个岛后，很难不把它与无尽的废弃、腐烂的汽车联系起来。飞机残骸通常可以在距跑道 150 至 300 英尺（45 至 91 米）的地方发现。
三菱 G4M 轰炸机是最著名的残骸之一。这是一款中型轰炸机/鱼雷轰炸机，日本建造了 2,435 架该类型飞机。它有七名船员。另一件值得注意的残骸是日本中岛 B5N 鱼雷轰炸机。这些是三人舰载鱼雷轰炸机，日本建造了 1,149 架。还可以找到一些三菱 A6M 零式战斗机。
我发现了两架失事飞机的小尾翼，我认为它们是零式飞机，但它们没有标记，我无法确定。上面的谷歌地图屏幕截图标记了我在旧机场发现日本残骸的位置。可能还会发现更多，但这是私人土地，丛林极其茂密，移动和能见度都非常困难。
雅浦岛的日本飞机（根据 1944 年美国侦察）
机场周围随处可见美国轰炸造成的巨大弹坑。我习惯在越南寻找这些弹坑。在越南的美山古迹中可以看到许多这样的生物，但它们似乎总是很难在照片中辨认出来，尤其是当它们被茂密的丛林包围时。我发现的一架飞机残骸靠近一个炸弹坑，我必须在弹坑里爬进爬出才能绕过飞机的残骸。
在岛上，我看到了许多其他二战遗迹。其中包括一门标记清晰的日本 88 型 75 毫米高射炮，保存在一些零式战斗机旁边。在俯瞰科洛尼亚主要定居点的主山上，我发现了另外四门日本枪，枪管已被摧毁。这些都有标记，但它们杂草丛生，而且标记基本上已经消失了。

title_en: New FAA Rule For Planes Lining Up On Runways May Cause Delays
title_zh: 美国联邦航空局关于飞机在跑道上排队的新规定可能会导致延误
summary: The FAA now requires a dedicated supervisor or controller-in-charge for "line up and wait" runway clearances, and one pilot already thinks that's going to cause delays.
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局现在需要一名专门的主管或负责管制员来“排队等待”跑道许可，一名飞行员已经认为这将成为现实
body_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has just added some new restrictions to how air traffic controllers can clear aircraft to “line up and wait” on the runway, in anticipation of takeoff clearance. This is intended to add an extra safety buffer, but to quote an airline pilot on an ATC frequency, “that’s probably going to cause some delays, that’s for sure.”
New restrictions on planes holding on runway for takeoff

As of today (November 24, 2026), the FAA has introduced a new rule regarding how aircraft can be cleared onto runways at airports. Air traffic controllers want to utilize runways as efficiently as possible for both takeoffs and landings, and that often involves having planes line up on the runway and wait, in anticipation of takeoff clearance.

To give an example, sometimes a plane will be cleared for takeoff, and then a bit of separation is required until the next plane can depart. In those situations, it’s common for the air traffic controller to clear that next plane to “line up and wait.”

The idea is that the plane then has clearance to enter the runway, and then await further takeoff clearance. After all, it might take 30 seconds or so for a plane to taxi from the hold short point of the runway, to getting into position on the runway.

Under the new FAA rules, air traffic controllers will only be allowed to clear pilots to “line up and wait” in situations where there’s a dedicated supervisor or controller-in-charge who can’t perform other duties while these operations are underway. In the past this was a recommendation, but now this is a rule.
Given constant air traffic control staffing shortages, this could actually impact operations a good percentage of the time. Here’s how the reason for this policy change is described

The core purpose of this change is to elevate the safety standard for Line Up and Wait (LUAW) operations by removing ambiguity in staffing requirements. By upgrading the guidance from “should” (a recommendation) to “must” (a mandatory requirement), the FAA ensures that the personnel providing watch supervision (OS/CIC) are fully dedicated to overseeing the safety of the operation without the distraction of simultaneously managing other operational tasks.
How big of a deal is this runway policy change?

I can appreciate the concept behind this, which is to improve safety. After all, we have air traffic controllers who are spread too thin, and all too often, they get a bit distracted due to the volume of things they have to deal with. That has definitely been a contributing factor to many accidents and incidents over the years.

I do find the timing of this being introduced to be interesting, as it comes during one of the busiest travel periods of the year. I don’t think this will actually lead to any major issues, and for that matter, safety shouldn’t be compromised just because flights are busy.

If you’re an observant passenger who is always looking out the window and is on Flightradar24, you may notice this policy in practice, for situations where you feel like the plane should already be lining up on the runway, but isn’t.

I can’t imagine this policy change will lead to any major delays on a widespread basis, but then again, given how at capacity many airports are, even a little change can make a big difference. Below you can hear some talk between an air traffic controller at Albuquerque Airport (ABQ) and a Southwest pilot, where they’re discussing the change. As you can hear, the pilot says “that’s probably going to cause some delays, that’s for sure.”
A new FAA runway safety requirement takes effect across the United States tomorrow, November 24, and an air traffic controller in Albuquerque is already warning pilots about possible delays.
The change requires airports to have a dedicated supervisor on duty before controllers… pic.twitter.com/zxXariHNAy

While the FAA is making changes intended to improve safety, how about also requiring air traffic controllers in the United States to start using standard phraseology, like everywhere else in the world? 😉

As of today, the FAA has added a new restriction on planes being able to line up on runways. A “line up and wait” procedure is pretty standard, but will now only be allowed in situations where the air traffic controller is only focused on one thing. Given how short staffed air traffic control often is, this could have some implications.
I don’t think this will meaningfully slow things down on a national level, but for airports that make the most of every second to get planes in and out, it could definitely have implications.
What do you make of the FAA’s new restrictions on takeoff?
body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 刚刚对空中交通管制员如何允许飞机在跑道上“排队等待”以等待起飞许可增加了一些新的限制。这样做的目的是增加额外的安全缓冲，但引用一位航空公司飞行员在空中交通管制频率上的话，“这可能会导致一些延误，这是肯定的。”
对飞机在跑道上起飞的新限制
自今天（2026 年 11 月 24 日）起，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 推出了一项关于如何允许飞机进入机场跑道的新规则。空中交通管制员希望尽可能有效地利用跑道进行起飞和着陆，这通常需要让飞机在跑道上排队等待，以等待起飞许可。
举个例子，有时一架飞机将获准起飞，然后需要进行一些分离，直到下一架飞机可以起飞。在这种情况下，空中交通管制员通常会允许下一架飞机“排队等待”。
这个想法是，飞机随后获得进入跑道的许可，然后等待进一步的起飞许可。毕竟，飞机从跑道的短等待点滑行到进入跑道位置可能需要 30 秒左右的时间。
根据美国联邦航空局的新规定，只有在有专门的主管或负责管制员在这些操作进行期间无法履行其他职责的情况下，空中交通管制员才可以允许飞行员“排队等待”。过去这是建议，但现在这是规则。
鉴于空中交通管制人员持续短缺，这实际上可能会在很大程度上影响运营。以下是此次政策变更的原因描述
此变更的核心目的是通过消除人员配置要求中的模糊性来提高排队等待 (LUAW) 操作的安全标准。通过将指南从“应该”（建议）升级为“必须”（强制性要求），FAA 可确保提供值班监督的人员 (OS/CIC) 完全致力于监督运行安全，而不会因同时管理其他运行任务而分心。
这次跑道政策的改变有多大影响？
我很理解这背后的理念，那就是提高安全性。毕竟，我们的空中交通管制员分布得太分散，而且他们常常因为要处理的事情太多而有点分心。这无疑是多年来发生许多事故和事故的一个因素。
我确实发现引入这一点的时机很有趣，因为它发生在一年中最繁忙的旅行时期之一。我认为这实际上不会导致任何重大问题，就此而言，安全不应仅仅因为航班繁忙而受到损害。
如果您是一位细心的乘客，总是看着窗外，并且使用 Flightradar24，您可能会在实践中注意到此政策，因为您可能会觉得飞机应该已经在跑道上排队，但事实并非如此。
我无法想象这一政策变化会导致大范围的重大延误，但话又说回来，考虑到许多机场的容量，即使是很小的变化也会产生很大的影响。下面您可以听到阿尔伯克基机场 (ABQ) 的空中交通管制员和西南航空飞行员之间的谈话，他们正在讨论这一变化。正如你所听到的，飞行员说：“这可能会导致一些延误，这是肯定的。”
FAA 新的跑道安全要求将于明天（11 月 24 日）在全美生效，阿尔伯克基的一名空中交通管制员已经向飞行员发出可能出现延误的警告。
这一变化要求机场在管制员之前有一名专门的值班主管…… pic.twitter.com/zxXariHNAy
虽然美国联邦航空局正在做出旨在提高安全性的改变，但是否也要求美国的空中交通管制员开始使用标准用语，就像世界其他地方一样？ 😉
截至今天，美国联邦航空局对飞机在跑道上排队增加了新的限制。 “排队等待”程序是相当标准的，但现在只有在空中交通管制员只专注于一件事的情况下才允许。考虑到空中交通管制人员的短缺，这可能会产生一些影响。
我认为这不会在国家层面上显着减缓速度，但对于充分利用每一秒让飞机进出的机场来说，这肯定会产生影响。
您如何看待美国联邦航空局的新起飞限制？

title_en: 34-Year-Old FedEx McDonnell Douglas MD-11 Overshoots Runway In Miami, Triggers Ground Stop
title_zh: 已有 34 年历史的联邦快递麦道 MD-11 飞机在迈阿密冲出跑道，触发地面停止
summary: No injuries have been reported.
summary_zh: 目前还没有人员受伤的报告。
body_en: An aviation geek at heart, Channing enjoys the thrill of covering some of the industry's top headlines. With nearly a decade of professional experience, his longtime passion for traveling and airplanes brings a unique approach to his reporting. Channing holds a degree in broadcast journalism and spends some time freelancing in local news. US West Coast-based.
This article covers a developing story. Continue to check back with us as we will be adding more information as it becomes available.
*Last Updated: 11:40 PM EST November 25, 2026, by Channing Reid

A McDonnell Douglas MD-11 , operated by FedEx Express , overran a runway upon arrival at Miami International Airport (MIA) on Wednesday. The incident triggered the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to impose a ground stop, putting a wrench in the peak of the Thanksgiving travel rush.

It is unclear what may have caused the trijet to veer off the runway, but weather radar indicated rain at the time of landing. It comes less than three months after an Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F overran a runway at MIA , killing five people.
Flights Have Resumed, But Delays Are Mounting
MIA has become fully operational, with all flights allowed to resume. However, delays are estimated to be nearly four hours. Over 530 flights were reported to be delayed as of 11:40 PM.
Miami is the third-most popular tourist destination for Thanksgiving, according to Washington Examiner journalist Anna Giaritelli​​​​​​ .
Landing Occurred Amid Harsh Weather: "The Most Dangerous Operation I've Seen"

Miami and surrounding areas were dealing with harsh rain conditions around the time of FX910's arrival. The weather in southeast Florida was described as a "black hole," according to Washington Examiner journalist Anna Giaritelli , who reportedly received a text from an off-duty air traffic controller minutes before the MD-11 landed at MIA.

"All the southeast traffic landing miami, lauderdale etc has basically ran into a black hole of weather. Commpand center didn't help us with routes, we lost our land lines to communicate with other facilities, over 10 sever(e) turbulence reports," they explained. "This was absolutely the most dangerous operation I've seen."

Video of the incident obtained by speedbirdHD shows the aircraft passing by on the runway. It appears the crew deployed the aircraft's reverse thrusters, attempting to slow down before overrunning the runway
FedEx confirmed the incident in a statement to Simple Flying on Wednesday. The company said it will coordinate with authorities as the investigation begins.

“FedEx Flight 910 from Memphis to Miami experienced an issue upon landing Wednesday evening at Miami International Airport. We are grateful that our crew is safe and there are no reported injuries. We are coordinating closely with investigating authorities, and any additional questions should be referred to the FAA.”
The ground stop was planned to last until 9:45 PM, according to CBS News . Around 9:40 PM, the FAA said the airport would "shortly" become operational again.

"Flights will be resuming shortly at Miami International Airport after FedEx Flight 910 ran off the runway after landing," the agency said. "The McDonnell Douglas MD-11 departed from Frederick W. Smith International Airport in Memphis. There are no reports of injuries. The FAA will investigate the incident."
At around 10:45 PM, MIA was gradually accepting some arriving flights via Runway 27 and Runway 30. However, several dozen flights were seen stuck on the tarmac awaiting departure clearances.
No Injuries Reported & Aircraft Remains Intact

MIA officials confirmed that Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units responded to the incident, and there were "no reported injuries." The extent of the damage to the aircraft is unclear. However, the airframe's fuselage did not separate, according to Enilria, indicating that severe external damage may not have been sustained.
Simple Flying contacted FedEx late Wednesday, but representatives could not be immediately reached for comment.
body_zh: 钱宁本质上是一名航空极客，他喜欢报道一些行业头条新闻的兴奋感。凭借近十年的专业经验，他对旅行和飞机的长期热情为他的报道带来了独特的方法。钱宁拥有广播新闻学学位，并花了一些时间在当地新闻领域担任自由职业者。总部位于美国西海岸。
本文讲述了一个正在发展的故事。请继续与我们联系，因为我们将在可用时添加更多信息。
*最后更新时间：美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 25 日晚上 11:40，作者：Channing Reid
周三，联邦快递运营的一架麦道 MD-11 飞机在抵达迈阿密国际机场 (MIA) 时冲出跑道。该事件引发美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）实施地面停飞，给感恩节旅行高峰带来了影响。
目前尚不清楚是什么原因导致三架喷气式飞机偏离跑道，但气象雷达显示着陆时有雨。不到三个月前，一架亚马逊 Prime Air 品牌的波音 767-300F 冲出迈阿密国际机场跑道，造成 5 人死亡。
航班已恢复，但延误情况越来越严重
澳门国际机场已全面投入运营，所有航班均获准恢复。然而，预计延误近四个小时。据报道，截至晚上 11 点 40 分，超过 530 架航班延误。
据《华盛顿观察报》记者 Anna Giaritelli 报道，迈阿密是感恩节第三大热门旅游目的地​​​​​​。
在恶劣天气下着陆：“我见过的最危险的行动”
FX910 抵达期间，迈阿密及周边地区正面临严酷的降雨天气。 《华盛顿观察报》记者 Anna Giaritelli 称，佛罗里达州东南部的天气被描述为“黑洞”。据报道，在 MD-11 降落在 MIA 前几分钟，她收到了一名下班空中交通管制员发来的短信。
“所有降落在迈阿密、劳德代尔堡等地的东南部航班基本上都陷入了天气黑洞。指挥中心没有帮助我们确定路线，我们失去了与其他设施通信的地面线路，收到了超过 10 份严重的湍流报告，”他们解释道。 “这绝对是我见过的最危险的手术。”
speedbirdHD获得的事件视频显示，飞机从跑道上飞过。机组人员似乎部署了飞机的反向推进器，试图在冲出跑道之前减速
联邦快递周三在给 Simple Flying 的一份声明中证实了这一事件。该公司表示，调查开始后将与当局协调。
“从孟菲斯飞往迈阿密的联邦快递 910 航班周三晚上在迈阿密国际机场降落时遇到了问题。我们很高兴我们的机组人员很安全，并且没有受伤的报告。我们正在与调查当局密切合作，任何其他问题应提交给美国联邦航空局。”
据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，地面停留计划持续到晚上 9 点 45 分。晚上 9:40 左右，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 表示，机场将“很快”恢复运营。
该机构表示：“联邦快递 910 航班着陆后冲出跑道后，迈阿密国际机场的航班很快就会恢复。” “麦道MD-11从孟菲斯弗雷德里克·W·史密斯国际机场起飞。目前没有人员受伤的报告。美国联邦航空局将调查这一事件。”
晚上 10 点 45 分左右，迈阿密国际机场逐渐接受部分经 27 号和 30 号跑道抵达的航班。然而，仍有数十架航班滞留在停机坪上等待起飞许可。
没有人员伤亡报告，飞机完好无损
迈阿密国际机场官员证实，迈阿密戴德消防救援队对这一事件做出了回应，“没有人员受伤的报告”。飞机受损程度尚不清楚。然而，根据恩尼尔里亚的说法，机身并未分离，这表明可能没有遭受严重的外部损坏。
Simple Flying 周三晚间联系了联邦快递，但未能立即联系到代表置评。

title_en: How Many Miles Per Gallon Does A Boeing 747 Get?
title_zh: 波音 747 每加仑可行驶多少英里？
summary: The 747 uses vast quantities of fuel, burning through 3,800 gallons every hour. This high fuel burn is equivalent to 0.19 mpg
summary_zh: 747 消耗大量燃油，每小时燃烧 3,800 加仑。这种高燃油消耗相当于 0.19 英里/加仑
body_en: Louis is a military historian and the staff writer for History of War magazine, a leading military history monthly. He also has an interest in private and commercial aviation.

With its four engines, the Boeing 747 uses vast quantities of fuel, burning through 3,800 gallons every hour. This high fuel burn amounts to 0.9 gallons used every second and 0.19 miles per gallon (mpg). In this article, we will detail the Boeing 747's mpg further, including the mpg per traveler, and how this compares to travel in a car and in modern airliners.
We will also delve into ongoing debates around sustainable aviation fuel to explore if aviation can be sustainable. After all, all airliners burn through staggering quantities of fuel.

According to the BBC's Future Planet, a cruising 747 burns through 0.9 gallons (four liters) of fuel each second. This is equivalent to 3,500 gallons (13,250 liters) of fuel every hour. If a 747 is cruising at its standard cruising speed of around 580 mph (933 km/h), it is covering a mile every 6.2 seconds.

Covering a mile requires 5.9 gallons of fuel. As a result, a cruising Boeing 747 can achieve just 0.18 miles per gallon. However, this is not the full picture, as a 747 carries far more people than most aircraft. For example, Qantas' 747-400s carried 364 passengers across three classes.

If we extrapolate this number of seats into the mpg that each passenger has, the data shows 65.5 mpg per passenger. According to calculatormpg.co.uk , the baseline for a good car mpg is 50. If a car is carrying two people, then the car is achieving 100 passenger miles per gallon.

This suggests that flying on a 747 still uses substantially more fuel than a car carrying multiple people, but less than a car carrying one person. The other difference to consider when comparing fuel consumption across modes of transport is that a 747 has to take off, which is not a concern for a car or train.

Takeoff is the most fuel-intensive part of any flight as the jet has to get up to speed while it is at its heaviest, and then climb to cruising altitude. The exact fuel consumption during takeoff depends hugely on how close the aircraft is to its maximum takeoff weight (almost a million pounds). However, the general quantity of fuel needed is approximately 5,000 gallons (19,000 liters).

This consumption of fuel equates to a fuel burn of approximately 154,000 lbs (70,000 kg) for a flight from London to New York. To sustain such a high consumption, a 747 can carry a vast amount of fuel. The debut 747 could carry 48,400 gallons (183,000 liters) of fuel . Later variants increased this capacity to 63,034 gallons (238,610 liters) for the 747-8.

This vast ocean of fuel is stored primarily in the aircraft's wings. A 747 has two main fuel tanks in each wing, with further reserve fuel tanks in the wings' outer sections and central wing tanks. It is common for airliners to store fuel in the wings to free up fuselage space for cargo storage.

The primary fuel tanks are usually filled first. Any further fuel needed for the flight is put into the central wing tank. Any final drops needed are pumped into the reserve tanks. Select 747 models can increase fuel capacity further by sealing off part of the horizontal stabilizer and using it as an additional auxiliary tank.

In recent years, the 747-400F's fuel storage has come under FAA scrutiny due to improperly applied cap seals on some aircraft. Should these seals fail during a lightning strike or short circuit, it could allow arcing within the fuel tanks and cause an explosion.

The FAA's attention came following several fuel tank explosions on commercial aircraft in the late 1990s. This led to a 2001 review titled ‘Transport Airplane Fuel Tank System Design Review, Flammability Reduction, and Maintenance and Inspection Requirements.’

The document led to a range of safety recommendations, including those relating to cap seals. In June 2022, the FAA responded to reports that cap seals were not being applied properly during production of the 747-400F. A design change omitted the application of the cap seals on eight fasteners, distributed equally across both wings.

At a surface level, the similar MPG per traveler between a 747 and a modern car would suggest a similar amount of environmental harm. Moreover, the US Energy Information Administration claims that jet fuel produces 21.1 lbs of CO2 per gallon, which is comparable to the 19.6 lbs of greenhouse gas produced from burning a gallon of gasoline.

However, focusing on CO2 alone hides the unique environmental harm caused by burning aviation fuel at altitude. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change points to the effects of water vapor clouds that contain black carbon, nitrous oxide, and sulfur dioxide.

Climate scientists use 'radiative forcing' as their measure for how environmentally harmful an activity is. A 2010 study by the University of Oslo’s International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis compared the radiative forcing of car and aircraft travel. The scientists concluded

"Air travel results in a lower temperature change per passenger-kilometer than car travel on the long run; the integrated radiative forcing of air travel is on short- to medium time horizons much higher than for car travel. Per passenger-hour traveled however, aviation’s climate impact is a factor 6 to 47 higher than the impact from car travel."

One reason the 747 burns so much fuel and has a poor mpg, causing greater environmental harm, is that it's an outdated airframe. This aircraft was first introduced in 1970, and the technology available 56 years ago was substantially less advanced than aircraft technology today.

As a result, the 747 would be considered incredibly inefficient if it were produced today. Furthermore, modern airliners are far lighter than the 747, needing less fuel for takeoff. 21st-century widebody, and notably two-engine, aircraft are far more efficient due to modern technology.
body_zh: 路易斯是一位军事历史学家，也是领先的军事历史月刊《战争史》杂志的特约撰稿人。他还对私人和商业航空感兴趣。
波音 747 配备四台发动机，消耗大量燃油，每小时燃烧 3,800 加仑。这种高燃油消耗相当于每秒消耗 0.9 加仑，每加仑 (mpg) 行驶 0.19 英里。在本文中，我们将进一步详细介绍波音 747 的每加仑英里数，包括每位旅客的每加仑英里数，以及与汽车和现代客机旅行的比较。
我们还将深入研究有关可持续航空燃料的持续辩论，以探讨航空是否可以可持续发展。毕竟，所有客机都会消耗惊人数量的燃料。
据 BBC 的《未来星球》报道，一架巡航 747 每秒消耗 0.9 加仑（四升）燃油。这相当于每小时 3,500 加仑（13,250 升）燃油。如果 747 以约 580 英里/小时（933 公里/小时）的标准巡航速度巡航，则每 6.2 秒可行驶一英里。
行驶一英里需要 5.9 加仑的燃油。因此，巡航波音 747 每加仑只能行驶 0.18 英里。然而，这并不是全部情况，因为 747 的载客量比大多数飞机都要多得多。例如，澳洲航空的 747-400 飞机分为三个舱位，可搭载 364 名乘客。
如果我们将座位数推断为每位乘客的英里/加仑，数据显示每位乘客的英里/加仑为 65.5 英里。根据 Calculatormpg.co.uk 的数据，一辆好汽车每加仑英里数的基准是 50 英里。如果一辆汽车载有两人，那么该汽车每加仑可行驶 100 英里。
这表明，乘坐 747 飞机飞行仍然比载客汽车消耗更多的燃料，但比载客汽车少。比较不同运输方式的燃油消耗时要考虑的另一个区别是 747 必须起飞，而汽车或火车则不需要担心这一点。
起飞是任何飞行中最耗油的部分，因为喷气式飞机必须在最重时加速，然后爬升至巡航高度。起飞期间的确切燃油消耗很大程度上取决于飞机与其最大起飞重量（几乎一百万磅）的接近程度。然而，一般所需燃料量约为 5,000 加仑（19,000 升）。
这一燃油消耗相当于从伦敦飞往纽约的航班大约消耗 154,000 磅（70,000 公斤）的燃油。为了维持如此高的消耗，747 可以携带大量的燃油。首次亮相的 747 可以携带 48,400 加仑（183,000 升）的燃油。后来的型号将 747-8 的容量增加到 63,034 加仑（238,610 升）。
这片巨大的燃料海洋主要储存在飞机的机翼中。 747 的每个机翼有两个主油箱，机翼外部和中央机翼油箱还有备用油箱。客机通常将燃料储存在机翼中，以腾出机身空间来存储货物。
主油箱通常首先被填充。飞行所需的任何其他燃料都放入中央机翼油箱中。任何需要的最后一滴都被泵入储备罐。选择 747 型号可以通过密封部分水平安定面并将其用作额外的辅助油箱来进一步增加燃油容量。
近年来，由于某些飞机上的盖密封应用不当，747-400F 的燃油储存已受到美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的审查。如果这些密封件在雷击或短路期间失效，可能会导致油箱内产生电弧并引起爆炸。
20 世纪 90 年代末发生多起商用飞机油箱爆炸事件后，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 开始关注此事。这导致了 2001 年题为“运输飞机燃油箱系统设计审查、易燃性降低以及维护和检查要求”的审查。
该文件提出了一系列安全建议，包括与瓶盖密封相关的建议。 2022 年 6 月，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 对有关 747-400F 生产过程中盖密封未正确应用的报告做出了回应。设计更改省略了八个紧固件上盖密封件的应用，这些紧固件均匀分布在两个机翼上。
从表面上看，747 和现代汽车的每位乘客 MPG 相似，这表明环境危害程度相似。此外，美国能源信息署声称，喷气燃料每加仑产生 21.1 磅二氧化碳，相当于燃烧一加仑汽油产生的 19.6 磅温室气体。
然而，仅仅关注二氧化碳掩盖了在高空燃烧航空燃料所造成的独特环境危害。政府间气候变化专门委员会指出了含有黑碳、一氧化二氮和二氧化硫的水蒸气云的影响。
气候科学家使用“辐射强迫”来衡量一项活动对环境的危害程度。奥斯陆大学国际应用系统分析研究所 2010 年的一项研究比较了汽车和飞机旅行的辐射强迫。科学家得出结论
“从长远来看，航空旅行导致每乘客公里的温度变化比汽车旅行更低；在中短期内，航空旅行的综合辐射力比汽车旅行高得多。然而，每乘客旅行一小时，航空对气候的影响比汽车旅行的影响高出 6 到 47 倍。”
747 燃烧大量燃油且每加仑英里数较差，造成更大的环境危害，原因之一是它的机身过时。这架飞机于 1970 年首次推出，56 年前的技术远不如今天的飞机技术先进。
因此，如果今天生产 747，它的效率将被认为极其低下。此外，现代客机比 747 轻得多，起飞时需要的燃油更少。得益于现代技术，21 世纪的宽体飞机，尤其是双引擎飞机的效率要高得多。

title_en: Norse Atlantic Collapses: Airline Cancels Flights, Strands Passengers
title_zh: 北欧大西洋航空公司崩溃：航空公司取消航班，乘客滞留
summary: Hours after calling its financial situation critical, Norse Atlantic canceled its flights and stranded travelers, including Pakistan International Airlines passengers. Here's how the airline got here.
summary_zh: 在称其财务状况危急数小时后，挪威大西洋航空取消了航班并导致包括巴基斯坦国际航空在内的旅客滞留
body_en: Back in August 2026, all-Boeing 787 airline Norse Atlantic Airways announced it was in a rough financial spot , and was pursuing a sale, merger, or other arrangement. Not a whole lot of progress was made in subsequent months, and just this morning, the airline announced that it was in a “critical” financial situation.
Well, it seems that it didn’t take long for things to get much worse, as the airline has seemingly canceled all flights just hours later, leaving travelers stranded.
The end is here for Norse Atlantic Airways, it seems
Earlier today, Norse Atlantic provided an update on its financial situation and ongoing strategic review. There’s no point in paraphrasing this, so here’s the direct statement from the airline

The Company’s financial situation is critical. It is dependent on securing financing to meet its short-term liquidity needs and to continue its operations. Norse, supported by its advisors, has explored various strategic alternatives and entertains discussions for a potential takeover. In parallel, the Board and management have diligently considered other available options, including ACMI contracts. Norse is also engaged in discussions with selected parties on short term financing, however, there can be no assurances that such discussions will result in a viable solution.

To state the obvious, this sounded really, really bad. When the company was publicly stating that its “financial situation is critical” and that it needed to secure financing to meet “short-term liquidity needs,” you knew things weren’t good. I expected we’d see something bad happen in the coming weeks, but it didn’t take that long.

Norse Atlantic has canceled its own scheduled flights effective immediately. On top of that, the airline was leasing two jets to Pakistan International Airlines, and those flights were also canceled with very little notice, “due to an unexpected operational suspension” by Norse Atlantic. Travelers were literally checking in at the airport when they realized the airline was grounded.
Due to an unexpected operational suspension by our wet-lease partner Norse Air without prior notice, tonight’s PK786 (London–Islamabad) & PK710 (Manchester–Lahore) are cancelled.
We deeply regret the disruption. Efforts have been made to mitigate the impact, and from tomorrow,…
So while the company hasn’t formally announced that it’s liquidating, it’s clear that operations are at least suspended, and we’ll see how this all plays out.
What has gone wrong with Norse Atlantic Airways?

The airline industry can be a funny business, and there’s no clearer example of that than Norse Atlantic Airways. The airline launched in 2022 , with the goal of operating long haul, low cost flights, particularly across the Atlantic.

That wasn’t exactly a unique business model, because this was exactly what Norwegian did, before it discontinued long haul flights in 2021 . Not only was the idea sort of copied, but Norse Atlantic had some executives from Norwegian, and even picked up the planes that Norwegian previously flew.

But as is all too common in the airline industry, clearly they thought it would be different this time around… it wasn’t. So in 2024 we saw the airline update its business model , making the focus less about operating regularly scheduled commercial flights, and more about leasing out aircraft, all while reducing its fleet.

The company got a lifeline when IndiGo decided to lease some Norse Atlantic 787s to dabble in long haul flying, ahead of the airline taking delivery of its own Airbus A350s . However, between all the airspace closures, high oil costs, and generally declining performance at IndiGo as the airline increasingly moved away from its core strengths, the airline recently decided to scrap that experiment, and stop leasing planes from Norse Atlantic.

Since then, opportunities for Norse Atlantic have been limited. The airline did manage to lease a couple of Dreamliners to the “new” Pakistan International Airlines , but for an airline with 12 planes, that hardly pays the bills.

Norse Atlantic did still operate some of its own flights, but in a very limited capacity. The airline had some flights from Europe to Thailand, South Africa, and the United States, but most were seasonal, and they were a fraction of what they previously were. Clearly they just didn’t have enough money to “keep the lights on” anymore.

I am curious to see what comes next for Norse Atlantic’s 787s. The airline doesn’t own them, but instead, they’ll presumably return to their leasing companies. I can’t help but point out that Southwest Airlines wants to start long haul flights . The airline had been considering a Boeing 787 order, and was possibly even looking at ways to get planes faster than from a direct order (which requires waiting for years).

Could these dozen Norse Atlantic 787s somehow end up at Southwest? The interiors would just need some updates (assuming the airline wants to offer business class), but talk about a quick way to grow a decent sized fleet.

This morning, Norse Atlantic released a statement admitting that its “financial situation is critical,” and that the company’s future is “dependent on securing financing to meet short-term liquidity needs.” That wasn’t exactly a great sign, but little did we know that the company would collapse just hours later, as the airline has now ceased all flying, including on a wet lease basis.
body_zh: 早在 2026 年 8 月，全波音 787 的航空公司挪威大西洋航空公司 (Norse Atlantic Airways) 宣布其财务状况不佳，正在寻求出售、合并或其他安排。接下来的几个月并没有取得太大进展，就在今天早上，该航空公司宣布其财务状况处于“危急”状态。
好吧，似乎没过多久事情就变得更糟了，因为航空公司似乎在几个小时后取消了所有航班，导致旅客滞留。
北欧大西洋航空公司的末日似乎已经来临
今天早些时候，北欧大西洋公司提供了其财务状况和正在进行的战略审查的最新信息。解释这一点没有意义，所以这是航空公司的直接声明
公司财务状况危急。它依赖融资来满足短期流动性需求并继续运营。 Norse 在其顾问的支持下，探索了各种战略选择，并就潜在收购进行了讨论。与此同时，董事会和管理层认真考虑了其他可用的选择，包括 ACMI 合同。 Norse 还与选定的各方就短期融资进行讨论，但不能保证此类讨论会产生可行的解决方案。
显而易见的是，这听起来真的非常糟糕。当该公司公开表示其“财务状况危急”并且需要获得融资以满足“短期流动性需求”时，你就知道情况并不好。我预计在接下来的几周内我们会看到一些不好的事情发生，但并没有花那么长时间。
挪威大西洋航空公司已立即取消其自己的定期航班。最重要的是，该航空公司向巴基斯坦国际航空公司租赁了两架飞机，而这些航班也在几乎没有通知的情况下被取消，“由于北欧大西洋航空公司意外暂停运营”。当旅客们在机场办理登机手续时，他们意识到航空公司已停飞。
由于我们的湿租赁合作伙伴 Norse Air 在没有事先通知的情况下意外暂停运营，今晚的 PK786（伦敦 - 伊斯兰堡）和 PK710（曼彻斯特 - 拉合尔）航班被取消。
我们对造成的干扰深表遗憾。我们已努力减轻影响，从明天开始……
因此，虽然该公司尚未正式宣布清算，但很明显，运营至少已暂停，我们将看看这一切将如何展开。
北欧大西洋航空公司出了什么问题？
航空业可能是一个有趣的行业，没有比挪威大西洋航空公司更清楚的例子了。该航空公司于 2022 年成立，目标是运营长途、低成本航班，特别是跨大西洋航班。
这并不是一种独特的商业模式，因为这正是挪威航空在 2021 年停止长途航班之前所做的。不仅这个想法被复制了，而且北欧大西洋航空还拥有一些来自挪威航空的高管，甚至还接收了挪威航空之前运营的飞机。
但正如航空业常见的情况一样，显然他们认为这一次会有所不同……但事实并非如此。因此，在 2024 年，我们看到该航空公司更新了其业务模式，不再关注运营定期商业航班，而是更多地关注飞机租赁，同时减少了机队数量。
在靛蓝航空接收自己的空客 A350 飞机之前，决定租赁一些 Norse Atlantic 787 飞机涉足长途飞行，该公司获得了一线生机。然而，由于空域关闭、高油价以及靛蓝航空公司的业绩普遍下滑（随着该航空公司逐渐偏离其核心优势），该航空公司最近决定放弃这一实验，并停止从挪威大西洋航空公司租赁飞机。
Since then, opportunities for Norse Atlantic have been limited.该航空公司确实设法向“新”巴基斯坦国际航空公司租赁了几架梦想飞机，但对于一家拥有 12 架飞机的航空公司来说，这几乎无法支付账单。
挪威大西洋航空公司仍然运营着一些自己的航班，但运力非常有限。该航空公司有一些从欧洲飞往泰国、南非和美国的航班，但大多数都是季节性的，而且数量只是以前的一小部分。显然，他们没有足够的钱来“维持正常运转”。
我很好奇 Norse Atlantic 的 787 飞机接下来会发生什么。航空公司并不拥有它们，但它们可能会回到租赁公司。我忍不住指出西南航空想要开通长途航班。该航空公司一直在考虑波音 787 订单，甚至可能正在寻找比直接订单（需要等待数年）更快的方式获得飞机。
这十几架 Norse Atlantic 787 会以某种方式最终降落在西南航空吗？内饰只需要一些更新（假设航空公司想要提供商务舱），但谈论一种快速发展规模适当的机队的方法。
今天上午，北欧大西洋公司发表声明，承认其“财务状况危急”，公司的未来“取决于获得融资以满足短期流动性需求”。这不是什么好兆头，但我们几乎不知道该公司会在几个小时后倒闭，因为该航空公司现已停止所有航班，包括湿租航班。

title_en: The Most Frequent JetBlue Airbus A320 Routes In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年捷蓝航空 A320 最频繁的航线
summary: JetBlue’s busiest A320 route in 2026 reveals a surprising Florida focus, raising questions about its expansion strategy, Spirit’s exit and fleet plans
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空 2026 年最繁忙的 A320 航线揭示了令人惊讶的佛罗里达州重点，引发了对其扩张战略、精神航空退出和机队计划的质疑
body_en: Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

JetBlue ’s busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is not a transcontinental link between two major business centers. According to Cirium , it is Orlando–San Juan, a leisure-heavy connection that recorded 3,562 flights in both directions in the supplied flight-tracking dataset. More revealing still, all 11 busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida, putting the airline’s New York roots alongside a network heavily concentrated in the Sunshine State.

That pattern raises a question a route ranking alone cannot answer: is JetBlue deliberately building a deeper Florida operation, or taking advantage of a gap left by the defunct Spirit Airlines while trying to improve its financial performance? The answer involves Orlando’s reach, Fort Lauderdale’s rapid expansion, the difference between counting flights and measuring capacity, and the A320’s role as JetBlue reshapes its fleet.
Orlando–San Juan Shows How JetBlue Builds High-Frequency Leisure Routes

Orlando–San Juan sits at the center of the pattern because it combines frequency with meaningful distance. JetBlue operated 1,782 flights from Orlando International Airport (MCO) to Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU) , offering 286,596 seats, and another 1,780 in the opposite direction, offering 286,380. Together, that is 3,562 flights and 572,976 seats across an average sector length of 1,189 miles (1,914 km).

The route generated approximately 681.3 million available seat miles (ASMs), or around 1.1 billion available seat kilometers. ASMs multiply the seats offered by the distance flown; they measure capacity, not passengers carried. The near-identical totals in each direction also suggest demand is relatively balanced rather than dominated by one-way seasonal traffic.

The route links two of the five cities where JetBlue described itself as a leading carrier in its January 2026 announcement: Orlando and San Juan. Leisure travelers and people visiting friends and relatives give the route more than one source of demand, helping support frequency without relying on traditional corporate traffic. But the lead over Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia is only 212 flights, or about 6%. Why, then, is Fort Lauderdale becoming such a consequential part of the airline’s plans?
Fort Lauderdale Has Become JetBlue’s Florida Growth Engine

Fort Lauderdale’s importance is rooted in JetBlue’s history as well as its current expansion. The airline’s first revenue flight in February 2000 connected New York-JFK with Fort Lauderdale. More than 25 years later, Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia remains one of its busiest A320 corridors, with 3,350 combined flights and 542,688 seats across 1,076 miles (1,732 km). Fort Lauderdale–San Juan follows with 3,280 flights and 531,288 seats over 1,046 miles (1,683 km).

The immediate catalyst is Spirit Airlines’ collapse. JetBlue moved to fill part of the gap and said it intended to reach around 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale by year-end. Its July announcement put summer departures near 130, more than 75% above 2025 levels, while adding service to destinations including Baltimore, Charlotte, Cleveland, Nashville, Detroit, Houston, Chicago and Ponce. CBS Miami reported on the expansion as an effort to fill gaps left by Spirit.

The plan is about more than replacing individual routes. As documented by Aviation Week, JetBlue has discussed as many as 370 connecting itineraries through Fort Lauderdale , giving the airport a larger role in the network. The fixed flight dataset may under-represent recently launched services, so the current route mix is a snapshot rather than a final picture of the expansion. The leading routes nevertheless show how Florida connects to JetBlue’s wider network
Orlando Reveals How Deep JetBlue’s Florida Network Has Become

Orlando’s footprint is broader than the leading San Juan route suggests. Across the six city pairs in the 11-route group that cross Orlando, the airport accounts for 14,507 flights. Fort Lauderdale accounts for 10,981 across four pairs, while West Palm Beach contributes another 2,156 through its Westchester service. JetBlue’s Florida presence is therefore spread across three airports rather than resting on one dominant base.

Orlando represents about 52% of the flights in the 11-route group. Fort Lauderdale’s role is different: it combines New York services with Caribbean flying and a fast-growing list of new destinations. New York remains the other half of the pattern, with seven of the 11 city pairs connecting a New York-area airport — JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, or Westchester — with Florida. Boston and San Juan account for two pairs each.

The New York side is changing too. JFK’s New Terminal One has slipped to early 2027, while Terminal 6 is expected to host JetBlue, according to Simple Flying reporting . With service spread across four New York-area airports, the airline must balance geographic coverage against overlapping capacity. And flight totals alone cannot show which routes contribute most to the network’s capacity: how does the picture change when distance is included?
Seat-Miles Show Why Flight Counts Can Be Misleading

A flight count treats every departure equally, whether it covers 944 miles (1,519 km) or 1,237 miles (1,991 km). ASMs provide another perspective by multiplying seats offered by distance flown. Orlando–San Juan remains the largest route on this measure, at approximately 681.3 million ASMs. Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia follows with 583.9 million, while Fort Lauderdale–San Juan generates about 555.7 million.

The movement further down the network is more revealing. Fort Lauderdale–Boston recorded 2,151 flights over an average distance of 1,237 miles (1,991 km), producing about 430.7 million ASMs. Orlando–Boston operated more flights, at 2,222, but its shorter 1,121-mile (1,804-km) sector generated approximately 398.9 million ASMs. Fort Lauderdale–Boston therefore contributes more capacity despite operating fewer flights.

JetBlue’s third-quarter 2026 results underline why capacity and profitability must be considered separately. The airline reported an 18.4% increase in revenue per available seat mile (RASM), while average fuel reached $3.91 per gallon, 57% higher year over year. Its third-quarter results release also said BlueFirst, its new domestic first-class product, would begin operating on Boston–Fort Lauderdale on December 8. That longer route gains importance when capacity is measured in seat-miles, and the premium product suggests JetBlue sees an opportunity to earn more from at least some of its Florida services. What does the A320 cabin itself reveal about how the airline matches capacity to demand?
A320 Seat Counts Reveal How JetBlue Uses Different Cabin Configurations
body_zh: 安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。
捷蓝航空 2026 年最繁忙的空客 A320 航线并不是两个主要商业中心之间的横贯大陆的航线。根据 Cirium 的说法，它是奥兰多-圣胡安，这是一条以休闲为主的航线，在提供的航班跟踪数据集中记录了 3,562 个双向航班。更能说明问题的是，所有 11 个最繁忙的 A320 城市航班均飞往佛罗里达州，使该航空公司的根基位于纽约，网络主要集中在阳光之州。
这种模式提出了一个单靠航线排名无法回答的问题：捷蓝航空是故意在佛罗里达州建立更深层次的业务，还是利用已倒闭的精神航空留下的空白，同时试图改善其财务业绩？答案涉及奥兰多的覆盖范围、劳德代尔堡的快速扩张、航班计数和运力测量之间的差异，以及 A320 在捷蓝航空重塑其机队过程中所扮演的角色。
奥兰多-圣胡安展示捷蓝航空如何打造高频休闲航线
奥兰多-圣胡安位于该模式的中心，因为它将频率与有意义的距离结合在一起。捷蓝航空运营着从奥兰多国际机场 (MCO) 飞往路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林国际机场 (SJU) 的 1,782 趟航班，提供 286,596 个座位，以及相反方向的 1,780 个航班，提供 286,380 个座位。航段平均长度为 1,189 英里（1,914 公里），共有 3,562 个航班和 572,976 个座位。
该航线产生了约 6.813 亿可用座位英里 (ASM)，或约 11 亿可用座位公里。 ASM 提供的座位数乘以飞行距离；他们衡量的是容量，而不是载客量。每个方向上几乎相同的总数也表明需求相对平衡，而不是由单向季节性交通主导。
该航线连接捷蓝航空在 2026 年 1 月的声明中将自己描述为领先航空公司的五个城市中的两个：奥兰多和圣胡安。休闲旅客和探亲访友为该路线提供了不止一种需求来源，有助于在不依赖传统企业流量的情况下支持频率。但仅领先劳德代尔堡-拉瓜迪亚机场 212 个航班，即 6% 左右。那么，为什么劳德代尔堡会成为该航空公司计划中如此重要的一部分呢？
劳德代尔堡已成为捷蓝航空佛罗里达州的增长引擎

劳德代尔堡的重要性植根于捷蓝航空的历史及其当前的扩张。该航空公司于 2000 年 2 月开通了首个收益航班，连接纽约肯尼迪机场和劳德代尔堡。 25 年多后，劳德代尔堡-拉瓜迪亚机场仍然是最繁忙的 A320 走廊之一，共有 3,350 个航班和 542,688 个座位，全长 1,076 英里（1,732 公里）。劳德代尔堡-圣胡安紧随其后，共有 3,280 个航班和 531,288 个座位，航程 1,046 英里（1,683 公里）。
直接的催化剂是精神航空公司的倒闭。捷蓝航空已采取行动填补部分缺口，并表示计划在年底前将每日从劳德代尔堡出发的航班数量增至约 150 趟。该公司 7 月份宣布，夏季出发航班数量接近 130 个，比 2025 年的水平高出 75% 以上，同时增加了飞往巴尔的摩、夏洛特、克利夫兰、纳什维尔、底特律、休斯顿、芝加哥和庞塞等目的地的航班。哥伦比亚广播公司迈阿密报道称，此次扩张是为了填补精神号留下的空白。
该计划不仅仅是更换个别路线。据《航空周刊》报道，捷蓝航空已经讨论了多达 370 个经劳德代尔堡转机的航线，使机场在网络中发挥了更大的作用。固定航班数据集可能不足以代表最近推出的服务，因此当前的航线组合只是快照，而不是扩展的最终图片。尽管如此，主要航线还是展示了佛罗里达州如何连接捷蓝航空更广泛的网络
奥兰多揭示捷蓝航空佛罗里达网络的深度
奥兰多的足迹比主要的圣胡安路线更广泛。在穿越奥兰多的 11 条航线中的 6 个城市对中，该机场共有 14,507 个航班。劳德代尔堡的四对航班共运送了 10,981 趟航班，而西棕榈滩则通过其威彻斯特航班运送了另外 2,156 趟航班。因此，捷蓝航空在佛罗里达州的业务分布在三个机场，而不是集中在一个主要基地。
奥兰多航班约占 11 条航线组中航班的 52%。劳德代尔堡的角色有所不同：它将纽约服务与加勒比海航班以及快速增长的新目的地列表结合起来。纽约仍然是该模式的另一半，11 个城市对中的 7 个将纽约地区的机场（肯尼迪机场、拉瓜迪亚机场、纽瓦克机场或威彻斯特机场）与佛罗里达州连接起来。波士顿和圣胡安各占两对。
纽约方面也在发生变化。据 Simple Flying 报道，肯尼迪国际机场的新一号航站楼已推迟到 2027 年初，而 6 号航站楼预计将迎来捷蓝航空。由于服务遍及纽约地区的四个机场，该航空公司必须在地理覆盖范围与重叠运力之间取得平衡。仅凭航班总数并不能显示哪些航线对网络容量贡献最大：如果考虑到距离，情况会如何变化？
座位里程显示为什么航班计数可能会产生误导
航班计数对每次出发均一视同仁，无论其飞行里程为 944 英里（1,519 公里）还是 1,237 英里（1,991 公里）。 ASM 通过将提供的座位数乘以飞行距离来提供另一种视角。奥兰多至圣胡安仍然是最大的航线，约有 6.813 亿架次 ASM。劳德代尔堡-拉瓜迪亚机场紧随其后，为 5.839 亿，而劳德代尔堡-圣胡安则为 5.557 亿。
网络下游的运动更具启发性。劳德代尔堡-波士顿记录了 2,151 次飞行，平均飞行距离为 1,237 英里（1,991 公里），生产了约 4.307 亿枚 ASM。奥兰多-波士顿运营的航班数量较多，达到 2,222 架，但其较短的 1,121 英里（1,804 公里）航段产生了约 3.989 亿架次 ASM。因此，尽管运营的航班较少，劳德代尔堡-波士顿仍贡献了更多的运力。

捷蓝航空 2026 年第三季度业绩凸显了为什么必须单独考虑运力和盈利能力。该航空公司报告称，每可用座位英里收入 (RASM) 增长了 18.4%，平均燃油达到每加仑 3.91 美元，同比增长 57%。捷蓝航空在第三季度业绩发布中还表示，其新的国内头等舱产品 BlueFirst 将于 12 月 8 日开始在波士顿-劳德代尔堡航线上运营。当以座位英里来衡量运力时，这条较长的航线就显得尤为重要，而这款优质产品表明捷蓝航空看到了至少从其佛罗里达州部分航班中赚取更多收入的机会。 A320 客舱本身揭示了航空公司如何匹配运力与需求的哪些信息？

title_en: Ukraine says strike on major Russian air base damaged five military jets
title_zh: 乌克兰称对俄罗斯主要空军基地的袭击损坏了五架军用飞机
summary: Ukraine said it damaged three MiG-31 fighters and two Su-34 fighter-bombers in a strike on Russia’s Savasleyka air… The post Ukraine says strike on major Russian air base damaged five military jets appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 乌克兰表示，在对俄罗斯萨瓦斯利卡空军基地的袭击中，三架米格 31 战斗机和两架苏 34 战斗轰炸机受损。
body_en: Ukraine said it damaged three MiG-31 fighters and two Su-34 fighter-bombers in a strike on Russia’s Savasleyka air base, which Russian aircraft use to launch Kinzhal missiles at Ukraine.

Ukraine’s General Staff said the attack took place during a series of strikes on November 24 and overnight into November 25, 2026. Its preliminary assessment was that all five aircraft would be unable to fly for some time.
The military said it was still assessing the extent of the damage and the number of jets affected. Russia did not immediately comment.

Savasleyka is in Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod region, east of Moscow. Ukraine’s military said Russia uses the base to launch MiG-31s carrying Kinzhal air-launched ballistic missiles, which it has fired at Ukrainian cities.
The General Staff also reported strikes on a radar station and several fuel and supply depots in Russian-occupied parts of eastern Ukraine during the same operation.

title_en: American Airlines’ Lag Linked To Flyers Unphased By Delta & United’s High Fares, Analyst Says
title_zh: 分析师称，美国航空的滞后与达美航空和联合航空的高票价取消航班有关
summary: American Airlines is investing heavily in its passenger experience as it struggles to match Delta and United's pricing power.
summary_zh: 美国航空正在大力投资其乘客体验，因为它很难与达美航空和联合航空的定价能力相媲美。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

American Airlines is struggling to match the financial performance of its two biggest domestic rivals, and passengers' willingness to pay higher fares to fly Delta Air Lines and United Airlines may be a major factor. According to Dan McKenzie, an analyst at Seaport Research Partners, both carriers command considerably higher fares than American on comparable flights, according to The New York Times .

McKenzie estimates that American needs approximately $4.5 billion in additional annual revenue to match its competitors' profit margins. With surging jet fuel costs pressuring airline profitability, the ability to command higher fares without significantly compromising demand has become increasingly important. American's latest disappointing financial results illustrate the scale of that challenge.
American Is Struggling To Match Its Rivals' Pricing Power

McKenzie's analysis found that Delta commands fares that are 12% above the industry average on similar flights, compared with 9% at United and just 3% at American. To illustrate, on a flight with an industry-average fare of $500, Delta could command $560 and United $545 without impacting demand, compared with $515 at American. Across millions of passengers, those differences quickly accumulate.

Interestingly, American achieved the strongest passenger yield growth of the three carriers during the third quarter of 2026. However, an analysis of their respective financial results reveals that American also experienced the largest decline in load factor. Consequently, its passenger revenue per available seat mile (PRASM) increased more slowly than at either Delta or United.

While American's faster capacity growth also contributed to its declining load factor, the results partly reflect a deliberate commercial strategy. The airline historically prioritized filling its aircraft, but is increasingly focused on improving yields. Speaking during American's third-quarter earnings call, Chief Commercial Officer Nat Pieper explained the trade-off.
"We have prioritized yield over load factor, proactively securing meaningfully higher yields in exchange for slightly lower loads."
Why Passengers Are Willing To Pay More For Delta & United

Delta and United have spent years differentiating their onboard products, recognizing the growing demand for premium travel. That strategy is delivering substantial financial returns. In the third quarter, United's premium and loyalty revenues both rose 17% year over year. Meanwhile, Delta's premium ticket revenue actually surpassed main cabin ticket revenue, with the latter accounting for less than 40% of its adjusted operating revenue.

Nowhere is this more evident than with corporate travelers, whose purchasing decisions are often influenced more by schedule convenience, operational reliability, and loyalty benefits than by fares. Delta topped the Business Travel News' 2026 Airline Survey for the 16th consecutive year, outperforming its competitors in eight of the 11 categories assessed. Despite substantial improvements, American remained the lowest-ranked qualifying airline.

Network composition is another important differentiator. Delta and United have greater exposure to affluent coastal markets, with both offering nearly twice as many departing seats from the most affluent, New York, as American. This also underscores the commercial significance of American's intensifying battle with United at Chicago O'Hare , where higher frequency and connectivity could help it secure more lucrative corporate travel contracts.
American Faces A Race Against Time To Close The Gap

American is pursuing a comprehensive transformation of its passenger experience, reversing several previous management decisions. These include reintroducing narrowbody seatback screens and substantially expanding premium seating. However, several of its most significant product enhancements will take years to implement across the fleet, delaying their full commercial impact.
Increase from 25% to approximately 40% of seats
Boeing 787-9s, Airbus A321XLRs and 777 retrofits
All 20 aircraft by 2027; premium seating increasing from 38% to 44%

There are encouraging signs that American's strategy is gaining traction. Its premium revenue increased 22.9% year-on-year in the third quarter, while managed corporate revenue increased 27.6%, marking its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. American's corporate travel satisfaction score has also improved this year, suggesting its efforts to rebuild relationships are paying dividends.

However, American is pursuing a moving target. While it prepares to begin installing Starlink in 2027, United already offers the service on more than half of its daily flights. And while Delta offers its personalized Delta Sync seatback entertainment experience on more than 900 aircraft, American will only begin its seatback screen rollout from 2028. So, as its rivals continue to reinvest profits in product differentiation, American's ultimate challenge will be persuading passengers that its flights are equally worth paying more for.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
美国航空正在努力追赶其国内两个最大竞争对手的财务业绩，乘客愿意支付更高的票价乘坐达美航空和联合航空可能是一个主要因素。据《纽约时报》报道，Seaport Research Partners 分析师丹·麦肯齐 (Dan McKenzie) 表示，两家航空公司的同类航班票价均远高于美国航空。
麦肯齐估计，美国航空每年需要大约 45 亿美元的额外收入才能与竞争对手的利润率相匹配。随着航空燃油成本的飙升给航空公司的盈利能力带来压力，在不显着影响需求的情况下提高票价的能力变得越来越重要。美国航空最近令人失望的财务业绩说明了这一挑战的规模。
美国航空正在努力追赶竞争对手的定价能力
麦肯齐的分析发现，达美航空的类似航班票价比行业平均水平高出 12%，而联合航空的票价为 9%，美国航空的票价仅为 3%。举例来说，对于行业平均票价为 500 美元的航班，达美航空和联合航空的票价分别为 560 美元和 545 美元，而不会影响需求，而美国航空的票价为 515 美元。在数百万乘客中，这些差异很快就会累积。
有趣的是，美国航空在 2026 年第三季度实现了三大航空公司中最强劲的乘客收益率增长。然而，对各自财务业绩的分析显示，美国航空的载客率下降幅度也是最大的。因此，其每可用座位英里乘客收入 (PRASM) 的增长速度比达美航空或美联航要慢。
虽然美国航空较快的运力增长也导致载客率下降，但这一结果在一定程度上反映了其深思熟虑的商业策略。该航空公司历来优先考虑飞机的装满，但现在越来越注重提高产量。在美国航空第三季度财报电话会议上，首席商务官纳特·皮珀 (Nat Pieper) 解释了这种权衡。
“我们优先考虑产量而不是负载率，主动确保有意义的更高产量，以换取稍微降低的负载。”
为什么乘客愿意为达美航空和联合航空支付更多费用
达美航空和美联航认识到人们对优质旅行的需求不断增长，多年来一直致力于打造差异化的机上产品。该战略正在带来可观的财务回报。第三季度，美联航的保费收入和忠诚度收入均同比增长 17%。与此同时，达美航空的高级机票收入实际上超过了经济舱机票收入，后者占其调整后营业收入的比例不到40%。
这一点在商务旅客中表现得最为明显，他们的购买决策往往更多地受到日程便利性、运营可靠性和忠诚度福利的影响，而不是票价的影响。达美航空连续 16 年在《商务旅行新闻》2026 年航空公司调查中名列前茅，在 11 个评估类别中的 8 个类别中优于竞争对手。尽管取得了显着进步，美国航空仍然是排名最低的合格航空公司。
网络组成是另一个重要的区别因素。达美航空和联合航空在富裕的沿海市场拥有更多的业务，两家公司提供的从最富裕的纽约出发的出发座位数量几乎是美国航空的两倍。这也凸显了美国航空与联合航空在芝加哥奥黑尔机场激烈竞争的商业意义，更高的班次和连通性可以帮助美国航空获得更有利可图的商务旅行合同。
美国面临与时间的赛跑以缩小差距
美国航空正在寻求乘客体验的全面转型，推翻了之前的几项管理决策。其中包括重新引入窄体座椅靠背屏幕和大幅扩大高级座椅。然而，其几个最重要的产品增强功能将需要数年时间才能在整个机队中实施，从而延迟了其全面的商业影响。
席位从 25% 增加至约 40%
波音 787-9、空客 A321XLR 和 777 改装
到 2027 年全部 20 架飞机；高级座位从 38% 增加到 44%
有令人鼓舞的迹象表明美国航空的战略正在获得支持。第三季度保费收入同比增长22.9%，管理企业收入增长27.6%，连续第六个季度实现两位数增长。美国航空今年的商务旅行满意度得分也有所提高，这表明其重建关系的努力正在取得成效。
然而，美国航空正在追求一个不断变化的目标。虽然美联航准备在 2027 年开始安装星链，但它已经在超过一半的日常航班上提供该服务。虽然达美航空在 900 多架飞机上提供个性化的 Delta Sync 座椅靠背娱乐体验，但美国航空从 2028 年开始才开始推出座椅靠背屏幕。因此，随着竞争对手继续将利润再投资于产品差异化，美国航空的最终挑战将是说服乘客相信其航班同样值得支付更多费用。

title_en: JetBlue Cancels 11 International Routes: See Full List Now
title_zh: 捷蓝航空取消 11 条国际航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: They were from four US airports, with two hubs accounting for the bulk of the cuts...
